story.title: LARA'S PONYTAIL
paragraphs_en: "Wake up!, Lara". "Its time to rise and shine!", said her mother. Lara jumps out of bed and greets her mom,"good morning, mom", "I am very excited as today is the day for my first day of school!". Her mother replies,"Yes, I know that. So stop wasting time and get ready." Lara happily agrees and gets to work. Lara had shifted to India, 4 months ago. She had applied for a school which was called ' Jay Vidya International School.' Lara stayed with her mother in an apartment. As for her dad, he had to stay in Amsterdam for 6 more months!! Mom had got a job in India, so they had shifted to India. Lara often missed her dad, but every 6 months, he used to send gifts for her. The school was just opposite the apartment in which they lived in.

'Ding,Ding! Ding, Ding!, rang the school bell. Everyone went to their respective classes. Everyone was amazed to find a new student in the class. Lara got to know that her class teacher's name was 'Mrs. Chandrani .' As the prayers began, their class teacher entered the class. She was slim, beautiful and she carried a sweet smile on her face. Lara just loved her new class teacher!! Chandrani ma'am helped Lara throughout the day, until she had learned everything. That day, Lara made 6 friends in school. They were-Bella, Shawn, Annie, Ted,Nina and Juliet. Lara enjoyed her day at school very much.

At home, her mother was eager to know about Lara's first day in school. Lara returned home happily. She told her mother everything that happened.She also said that her teacher had told her to tie her hair in a ponytail. Her mother said that she would have to get up early in the morning.Lara agreed with her mother. She and her mother sat for dinner. The dinner consisted of- roast chicken, bread and fresh red raspberries with creamy looking cream!!! She soon finished her dinner and went to sleep. The next day, Lara got up early and her mother tied her hair in a simple ponytail which suited her perfectly. Lara was now very happy with her hair.

Her mother accompanied her to the school. On their way, they met Bella and Shawn. Lara walked together with her friends and said,"Just take a look at my ponytail!". Her friends agreed with her."Wow, Lara! That's an amazing ponytail that your mother has made", Bella said. "Thank you", said Lara.

At school , her day passed happily with everyone admiring her ponytail. Lara was indeed very happy! "Mom, where are you ??", cried Lara. "What happened ?", replied her mother. Lara could not control herself from joy !! Everyone in class was praising me for my ponytail". "Cool, I also thought the same thing", replied her mother."Tomorrow, you can tie your hair in a ponytail that is facing towards the left", added her mother."Alright", said Lara, pleased with herself."Now come for dinner", said her mom. Lara came to the table to find a huge pile of food waiting for her ! The huge pile consisted of- roasted turkey,roasted ch icken, pudding,strawberry tarts for dessert. Lara enjoyed her food very much indeed. She then went to sleep with her mother.

The next day, they got up early and started to get ready for school.Lara had her milk and bread and left for school with her mother, happily.Oh! and she didn't forget her ponytail! She did tie her hair as her mother had told. And she looked cute. Miss Chandrani was quite amazed at Lara's amazing hair styles which were done by her mother.Chandrani miss also noticed how students were praising Lara for her amazing hair styles.Indeed, Lara was quite happy with these compliments.In all the subjects, Lara was appreciated for her hair by the teachers! So, Chandrani miss made a new rule in her class: Everyone would follow Lara's hair styles everyday.

Everyone rejoice at this new rule.Even Lara took part in the celebration.After that,everyone went home happily,to tell their parents about the new rule in the class.Lara feeling grand,returned home. 'Listen,Mom' cried Lara,as soon as she entered.'Our teacher has made a new rule in the class',she said.'What's that,may i ask?,asked her mother.'Everyone will follow my hair styles in class!',said Lara.'That's awesome',replied her mother.'Yes',answered Lara,who was beside herself with joy.'What hairstyle should i do for tomorrow ?'asked Lara.'Well,i think you should tie your hair in two plaits,that will suit you,replied her mom.'Okay',then i will tie my hair in two plaits'!'Come for dinner,dear',said her mother

'I am coming mom',Lara replied.They finished they finished their dinner and slept. 'Good Morning,Lara', said her mom'Morning',Lara replied sleepily.'We have to tie your hair in two plaits,but if you don't get up in time,then no hairstyles from tomorrow ',said her mother,sharply.Lara leapt out of the bed and went to wash up.Soon,her mother was busy making the plaits of Lara's hair. At school,Lara was amazed to see that everyone has made two plaits! Everyone is everyone's ditto thought Lara.She was feeling proud that everyone was following her hairstyles including her.But,soon she started getting tired of everyone following her styles.She could not bear it anymore.
One day,she said to her class ,'Tomorrow i'll be bald and so will you',she said.But next day,Lara came to school with a simple pony tail.And she found her classmates all BALD!!!!

sentences.text_vi: Một ngày nọ, cô bé nói với cả lớp: "Ngày mai tớ sẽ cạo trọc đầu và các cậu cũng vậy". Nhưng ngày hôm sau, Lara đến trường với một kiểu tóc đuôi ngựa đơn giản. Và cô bé thấy tất cả bạn học của mình đều TRỌC ĐẦU!!!!

items.text_en: "Wake up!, Lara".
"Its time to rise and shine!", said her mother.
Lara jumps out of bed and greets her mom,"good morning, mom", "I am very excited as today is the day for my first day of school!".
Her mother replies,"Yes, I know that.
So stop wasting time and get ready." Lara happily agrees and gets to work.
Lara had shifted to India, 4 months ago.
She had applied for a school which was called ' Jay Vidya International School.' Lara stayed with her mother in an apartment.
As for her dad, he had to stay in Amsterdam for 6 more months!!
Mom had got a job in India, so they had shifted to India.
Lara often missed her dad, but every 6 months, he used to send gifts for her.
The school was just opposite the apartment in which they lived in.
'Ding,Ding! Ding, Ding!, rang the school bell.
Everyone went to their respective classes.
Everyone was amazed to find a new student in the class.
Lara got to know that her class teacher's name was 'Mrs.
Chandrani .' As the prayers began, their class teacher entered the class.
She was slim, beautiful and she carried a sweet smile on her face.
Lara just loved her new class teacher!!
Chandrani ma'am helped Lara throughout the day, until she had learned everything.
That day, Lara made 6 friends in school.
They were-Bella, Shawn, Annie, Ted,Nina and Juliet.
Lara enjoyed her day at school very much.
At home, her mother was eager to know about Lara's first day in school.
Lara returned home happily.
She told her mother everything that happened.She also said that her teacher had told her to tie her hair in a ponytail.
Her mother said that she would have to get up early in the morning.Lara agreed with her mother.
She and her mother sat for dinner.
The dinner consisted of- roast chicken, bread and fresh red raspberries with creamy looking cream!!!
She soon finished her dinner and went to sleep.
The next day, Lara got up early and her mother tied her hair in a simple ponytail which suited her perfectly.
Lara was now very happy with her hair.
Her mother accompanied her to the school.
On their way, they met Bella and Shawn.
Lara walked together with her friends and said,"Just take a look at my ponytail!".
Her friends agreed with her."Wow, Lara!
That's an amazing ponytail that your mother has made", Bella said.
"Thank you", said Lara.
At school , her day passed happily with everyone admiring her ponytail.
Lara was indeed very happy!
"Mom, where are you ??", cried Lara.
"What happened ?", replied her mother.
Lara could not control herself from joy !!
Everyone in class was praising me for my ponytail".

"Cool, I also thought the same thing", replied her mother."Tomorrow, you can tie your hair in a ponytail that is facing towards the left", added her mother."Alright", said Lara, pleased with herself."Now come for dinner", said her mom.
Lara came to the table to find a huge pile of food waiting for her !
The huge pile consisted of- roasted turkey,roasted ch icken, pudding,strawberry tarts for dessert.
Lara enjoyed her food very much indeed.
She then went to sleep with her mother.
The next day, they got up early and started to get ready for school.Lara had her milk and bread and left for school with her mother, happily.Oh!
and she didn't forget her ponytail!
She did tie her hair as her mother had told.
And she looked cute.

Miss Chandrani was quite amazed at Lara's amazing hair styles which were done by her mother.Chandrani miss also noticed how students were praising Lara for her amazing hair styles.Indeed, Lara was quite happy with these compliments.In all the subjects, Lara was appreciated for her hair by the teachers!
So, Chandrani miss made a new rule in her class: Everyone would follow Lara's hair styles everyday.
Everyone rejoice at this new rule.Even Lara took part in the celebration.After that,everyone went home happily,to tell their parents about the new rule in the class.Lara feeling grand,returned home.

'Listen,Mom' cried Lara,as soon as she entered.'Our teacher has made a new rule in the class',she said.'What's that,may i ask?,asked her mother.'Everyone will follow my hair styles in class!',said Lara.'That's awesome',replied her mother.'Yes',answered Lara,who was beside herself with joy.'What hairstyle should i do for tomorrow ?'asked Lara.'Well,i think you should tie your hair in two plaits,that will suit you,replied her mom.'Okay',then i will tie my hair in two plaits'!'Come for dinner,dear',said her mother
'I am coming mom',Lara replied.They finished they finished their dinner and slept.

'Good Morning,Lara', said her mom'Morning',Lara replied sleepily.'We have to tie your hair in two plaits,but if you don't get up in time,then no hairstyles from tomorrow ',said her mother,sharply.Lara leapt out of the bed and went to wash up.Soon,her mother was busy making the plaits of Lara's hair.
At school,Lara was amazed to see that everyone has made two plaits!

Everyone is everyone's ditto thought Lara.She was feeling proud that everyone was following her hairstyles including her.But,soon she started getting tired of everyone following her styles.She could not bear it anymore.
One day,she said to her class ,'Tomorrow i'll be bald and so will you',she said.But next day,Lara came to school with a simple pony tail.And she found her classmates all BALD!!!!
